## What's new in 1.5.2

- **New app icon**: two intercoms linked peer to peer, replacing the default Flutter logo.
  - Android: launcher icon (adapts to round, squircle and themed icons on Android 8+) and a proper white icon in the status bar while running in the background.
  - Windows: window, taskbar, tray and installer. Linux: window, AppImage and tray.
- **Version shown in the app**: under the title in the top bar ("You are "Office-PC" · v1.5.2") and in **Settings → This device**. The headless node logs its version when it starts.
- The Mute, volume and camera buttons in a call now line up neatly.

Includes everything from 1.5.1: smooth switching between Wi-Fi, mobile data and VPNs, and calls that survive a network switch.

Upgrading: install over 1.2.0 or newer (same variant on Android). Settings and saved peers are kept. Works with 1.2.0 – 1.5.1; update both devices to get calls that survive a network switch. Versions before 1.2.0 (including 1.1.1) can't connect, because they don't encrypt. On Android and Windows the new icon may take a moment to show, or need a launcher/Explorer refresh, because the old one is cached.
